scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The one-site threshold is proved analytically from the published free-resolvent block formula and finite-dimensional singular-value geometry. The bundled computation is corroborative only; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific limitations/integrity.limitations: Only unrestricted complex 2-by-2 block potentials supported at one lattice site and targets in the resolvent set of the free operator are covered. Multi-site sharpness outside the diagonal-dominance region, embedded points, threshold points, and Hermitian or diagonal subclasses are not classified.

title: Exact one-site eigenvalue threshold for the non-self-adjoint discrete Dirac operator
